entities.summary: Margaret Booth was an American film editor. In a career lasting seven decades, Booth was most associated with Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM). Margaret Booth was a activists & reformers from Los Angeles (1898-01-16, Los Angeles–2002-10-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
